purpose: Preserve pre-branding upgrade registry identity while rendering AiGoodBro labels. Target-owned legacy MSI links are scheduled through standard RemoveFiles for native transaction rollback; other upstream gates are retained.

replacements.after:
; Stable upgrade identity predates the AiGoodBro display name.
!define LEGACYPRODUCTNAME "Codex Account Manager Next"
!define LEGACYMANUFACTURER "Codex Account Manager Next contributors"
!define UNINSTKEY "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\${LEGACYPRODUCTNAME}"

; Rename only our existing legacy shortcuts; never overwrite another shortcut.
!macro MigrateLegacyBrandShortcut FOLDER
  !insertmacro IsShortcutTarget "${FOLDER}\${LEGACYPRODUCTNAME}.lnk" "$INSTDIR\${MAINBINARYNAME}.exe"
  Pop $0
  ${If} $0 = 1
  ${AndIfNot} ${FileExists} "${FOLDER}\${PRODUCTNAME}.lnk"
    Rename "${FOLDER}\${LEGACYPRODUCTNAME}.lnk" "${FOLDER}\${PRODUCTNAME}.lnk"
  ${EndIf}
!macroend

Function CreateOrUpdateStartMenuShortcut
  !insertmacro MigrateLegacyBrandShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS\$AppStartMenuFolder"
  !insertmacro MigrateLegacyBrandShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS"

Function RestorePreviousInstallLocation
  ReadRegStr $4 SHCTX "${MANUPRODUCTKEY}" ""
  ${If} $4 == ""
    ; WiX records the same owned installation path under a named value.
    ReadRegStr $4 SHCTX "${MANUPRODUCTKEY}" "InstallDir"
  ${EndIf}
  StrCmp $4 "" +2 0
Software\Codex Account Manager Next contributors\Codex Account Manager Next

<InstallExecuteSequence>
            <RemoveShortcuts>Installed AND NOT UPGRADINGPRODUCTCODE</RemoveShortcuts>
            <Custom Action="PlanLegacyBrandShortcuts" Before="RemoveFiles">WIX_UPGRADE_DETECTED AND NOT Installed</Custom>
        </InstallExecuteSequence>

        <!-- Old MSI deliberately retains shortcuts during major upgrades. Plan only
             exact owned links in RemoveFile so the MSI transaction owns rollback. -->
        <CustomAction Id="PlanLegacyBrandShortcuts" Script="jscript" Execute="immediate" Return="check"><![CDATA[
var fs = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
var shell = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
function absolute(path) {
    if (!/^(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\\/]|\\\\[^\\]+\\[^\\]+\\)/.test(path)) {
        throw new Error("Expected an absolute installer path");
    }
    return fs.GetAbsolutePathName(path).replace(/\//g, "\\").toLowerCase();
}
function plainPath(path) {
    if ((fs.GetFile(path).Attributes & 1024) !== 0) return false;
    var parent = fs.GetParentFolderName(path);
    while (parent) {
        if ((fs.GetFolder(parent).Attributes & 1024) !== 0) return false;
        var next = fs.GetParentFolderName(parent);
        if (next.toLowerCase() === parent.toLowerCase()) break;
        parent = next;
    }
    return true;
}
var expected = absolute(fs.BuildPath(absolute(Session.Property("INSTALLDIR")), "codexu-tauri.exe"));
var candidates = [
    ["DesktopFolder", "ApplicationShortcutDesktop", "AiGoodBroLegacyDesktop", "AiGoodBroLegacyDesktopDirectory", ""],
    ["ProgramMenuFolder", "ApplicationShortcut", "AiGoodBroLegacyPrograms", "AiGoodBroLegacyProgramsDirectory", "Codex Account Manager Next"]
];
for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    var row = candidates[i];
    var folder = absolute(Session.Property(row[0]));
    if (row[4]) folder = fs.BuildPath(folder, row[4]);
    var path = fs.BuildPath(folder, "Codex Account Manager Next.lnk");
    var target;
    try {
        if (!fs.FileExists(path) || !plainPath(path)) continue;
        target = absolute(shell.CreateShortcut(path).TargetPath);
    }
    catch (error) { continue; } // Unknown or malformed links belong to the user.
    if (target !== expected) continue;
    Session.Property(row[3]) = folder;
    // Every SQL value is a fixed identifier/name above, never a filesystem value.
    var view = Session.Database.OpenView("INSERT INTO `RemoveFile` (`FileKey`, `Component_`, `FileName`, `DirProperty`, `InstallMode`) VALUES ('" + row[2] + "', '" + row[1] + "', 'Codex Account Manager Next.lnk', '" + row[3] + "', 1) TEMPORARY");
    view.Execute();
    view.Close();
}
        ]]></CustomAction>
